tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /nor lha dang dman pa'i chu sbyin brul gtor dang gtor ma brgya rtsa'i cho ga rnam 'dren sbyin pa'i shing rta sogs gtor chog gi rim pa bzhugs so/
༄༅/ /nor lha dang dman pa'i chu sbyin brul gtor dang gtor ma brgya rtsa'i cho ga rnam 'dren sbyin pa'i shing rta sogs gtor chog gi rim pa bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /nor lha dang dman pa'i chu sbyin brul gtor dang gtor ma brgya rtsa'i cho ga rnam 'dren sbyin pa'i shing rta sogs gtor chog gi rim pa bzhugs so//

bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten snod du bcud rnams gtor ma'i rgyu// phung khams skye mched gnyis med dag pa'i mgron// gtan pa med pa'i sbyin pas tshim mdzad pa'i// sbyin mkhas thub pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor pa gang zhig thun mtshams su gtor ma'i cho ga bya bar 'dod na/ skyabs sems spyi 'gro ltar sngon du 'gro bas/ thog mar dzaṃ bha la ser po'i chu sbyin ni/ snod du ril bu gcig blugs la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs| stong pa'i ngang las mdun du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dzaṃ las dzaṃ bha la ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas shing tog bi dza pū ra ka dang*/ g.yon ne'u le'i rkyal pa 'dzin pa/ utpa la'i phreng ba can/ zhabs kyis padma dung dang gter bdag mnan pa// ye shes pa dang dbyer med cing rin 'byung gi cod pan can du gyur par mos la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum brjod la chu gtor byin gyis brlabs te/ chu sbreng zhing*/ oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza lend+ra ye swā hā/ zhes chu 'bul la/ oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza lend+ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes gtor ma dbul la/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod cing*/ nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*// zhes sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ dngos grub blangs la chu gshegs/ ༈ /dzaṃ dmar gyi chu sbyin ni/ snod du ril bu gcig blug chus bran te/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du pad nyi'i gdan gyi steng du dzaṃ yig dmar po las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dzaṃ bha la sku mdog padma rā ga'i mdog can| zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhal g.yas dkar/ g.yon sngo/ dbus dmar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum mnga' ba/ phyag drug g.yas dang pos rin po che/ bar pas lcags kyu/ g.yon dang pos thod pa nor bus gang ba/ bar pas zhags pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis ne'u le nor gyis gang ba re re 'dzin pa/

dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum gyis gnod sbyin nor skyug gnyis gnyis mnan pa/ chags pa'i nyams can ye shes pa dang gnyis su med pa/ de'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas lha mo ku ru kulle dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis kyis mda' gzhu/ 'og ma gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ de'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas lha mo dmar mo lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa grangs med pa spros te/ gling bzhi'i zas nor thams cad bsdus te bdag sogs sems can thams cad dbul phongs kyi 'jigs pa las grol bar mdzad bzhin par gyur ces mos te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis chu gtor byin gyis brlabs la/ chu sbreng zhing*/ oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza lend+ra ya dha na me dhi hrīḥswā hā/ zhes chu dbul te/ slar yang*/ oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza lend+ra ya dha na me dhi hrīḥ i dam ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes gsum gyis gtor ma dbul la arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gi lha// thugs rjes chags pas sku mdog dmar por bzhugs| |dbang gi phrin las rdzogs mdzad dzaṃ bha lar// phyag 'tshal 'gro ba'i re ba skong du gsol// zhes bstod la/ bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsol bar bsams te dngos grub blangs shing chu gshegs la/ mi dmigs pas rgyas gdab par bya'o/// / ༈ /dzaṃ nag gi chu sbyin ni/ snod du ril bu gcig chus bran la/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du pad nyi'i gdan la dzaṃ nag po las 'phags pa rmugs 'dzin sku mdog nag po/ zhal gcig /phyag gnyis/ g.yas thod pa khrag gis bkang ba dang*/ g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ gcer bu brkyang bskum gyis nor bdag ser po mnan pa/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med cing mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can du gyur ces mos shing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis chu gtor byin gyis brlabs la/ chu sbreng zhing*/ oṃ ind+ra ni mu khaṃ bhra ma ri swā hā/

oṃ dzaṃ luṃ swā hā/ zhes chu phul la/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mo ma ṇi bha drā ya ma hā yakṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tadya thā/ oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza lend+ra ya sa pa ri wā ra ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes gsum gyis gtor ma dbul la/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod pa ni/ 'phags pa rmugs 'dzin chu dbang 'chol pa nag /mi'u thung gzugs 'chang gnod sbyin sde dpon che// khyod ni mi bskyod mchog tu bdag dran gyis// phyag 'tshal nor gyi dngos grub myur du stsol// zhes dngos grub blangs la chu gshegs so/// / ༈ /yi dwags chu sbyin ni/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kha sarpa ṇir gsal ba'i phyag nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas yi dwags kyi tshogs thams cad tshim par gyur ces mos te/ lag g.yon mchog sbyin gyi drung du chu sbreng zhing*/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ zhes ci rigs brjod la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi// phyag nas 'bab pa'i 'o rgyun gyis// yi dwags rnams ni tshims byas shing*/ khrus byas rtag tu bsil bar shog |ces brjod cing de'i mod la chu thigs gcig snod kyi phyi rol tu'ang blug cing se gol gcig gis sbyin la/ oṃ dzwa la mi daṃ sarba pre te bhyaḥswā hā/ 'jur gegs can la skom sel chab// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// 'jig rten khams 'dir ma lus pa// thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /ces brjod la chu gshegs/// / ༈ /bar do chu sbyin ni/ rang nyid spyan ras gzigs kha sarpa ṇir gyur pa'i phyag nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas bar do'i sems can rnams tshim par gyur ces mos la/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ trā sa ni trā sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba karma pa raṃ pa rā ṇi me sarba satwa nāñtsa swā hā/ bar do'i sems can thams cad bkres skom dang 'jigs skrag gi sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral zhing mi khom pa'i skye gnas khegs te myur du 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig

/ces chu gshegs/// / ༈ /brul gtor cha bzhi ni/ yo byad 'du byas te/ dang po bshams la/ a mṛ tas bsangs*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum dang kha 'bar ma'i sngags brjod de arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di/ bla ma yi dam longs spyod rdzogs pa sku'i zhing khams na bzhugs pa rnams la 'bul lo// bdag cag gis bla ma la ma dad cing ma gus pa bgyis pa dang*/ bla ma'i dkor la 'bags pa dang*/ theg pa chen po'i chos spangs pa la sogs pa dam tshig nyams chag thams cad byang zhing dag nas longs spyod rdzogs pa sku'i zhing khams su 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /gnyis pa bshams la/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum dang*/ kha 'bar ma'i sngags brjod cing*/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa la 'khor nyan thos rang sangs rgyas sprul pa sku'i zhing khams na bzhugs pa rnams la 'bul lo// bdag cag gis tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du sangs rgyas kyi dkor/ chos kyi dkor/ dge 'dun gyi dkor/ mar me'i dkor la 'bags pa la sogs pa dkor dang sku glud thams cad byang zhing dag nas sprul pa sku'i zhing khams su 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /gsum pa bshams la/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang kha 'bar ma'i sngags dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di pha mas gtsor byas pa'i 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la bsngo'o// lan chags bral/

bu lon 'khor/ zhe 'khon byang nas myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig /bzhi pa gong ltar la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di klu'i rgyal po wa ru ṇa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// 'dzam bu'i gling du char chu dus su 'bebs pa dang*/ lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa'i phrin las mdzod cig /klu rgyal kun gyi rjer gyur pa// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul rmad du byung*// klu rnams ma lus 'dul mdzad pa// wa ru ṇa la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod la gtor ma gshegs/ bshal chu btang ngo*/// / ༈ /gtor ma brgya rtsa'i rim pa ni/ yo byad 'du byas la/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po phul nas/ 'phags pa rnams mchod pas mnyes pa dang*/ rigs drug rnams gtan pa med pa'i sbyin pa rnam pa bzhis tshim par bya'o// zhes don dran pa'i ngang nas/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la rang nyid skad cig gis spyan ras gzigs kha sarpa ṇi gangs ri ltar dkar ba'i phyag gnyis mchog sbyin dang padma 'dzin pa zhi zhing 'dzum pa dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing zhabs gnyis mnyam par bzhengs pa/ 'od dpag med pa'i cod pan can ye shes pa dang dbyer med pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis gtor mgron 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ bla ma rgyal ba rgyal sras thugs rje can// dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron kun gshegs su gsol// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha'i tshogs// mgon po yon tan mgron kun gshegs su gsol// skye ba gtan gyi pha mar gyur pa yi// rigs drug snying rje'i mgron kun gshegs su gsol// 'khrul ba'i dbang gis gnod byed 'byung po bgegs// lan chags bu lon mgron kun gshegs su gsol// badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ bcom ldan 'khor bcas byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan// bdag gi mchod gtor bzhes slad du// dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol// padmā sa na tiṣṭha st+waṃ/

rab 'byams zhing gi mchod yon zhabs bsil dang*/ /me tog spos dang mar me dri yi chu/ /zhal zas rol mo srid pa gsum bkang ste// bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi// sems can rnams kyi don kun mdzad du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapad pra tītstsha swā' hā/ zhes mchod cing*/ rgyal ba'i sku la dri ma mi mnga' yang*// bdag sogs lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang ba'i phyir// dri med yan lag brgyad ldan gaṅgā'i chu// rgyun bzang rab tu gtams pas sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes khrus chu gshegs la bshal chu btang*/ de nas dkar gsum mngar gsum sman gyis sbags pa'i ril bu bcu tshan bcu dang brgyad tshan gcig byas pa'i/ bcu tshan dang po snod bcu'am lnga'am gcig tu bshams la/ chus sbyangs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'dod yon phun sum tshogs par gyur ces mos te/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐/ zhes bcu'am bdun nam gsum brjod la/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ gtor ma 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa 'di/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum// rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa yi dam rgyud sde bzhi dang gsang sngags gsar rnying gi lha tshogs thams cad la 'bul lo// bdag sogs sems can thams cad tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib gnyis byang nas myur du rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par mdzad du gsol/ bcu tshan gnyis pa bshams la/ mchod pa'i bar gong ltar la/ gtor ma 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa 'di/ rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang*/ dpal nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/

lha klu phyogs skyong rgyal chen gza' skar 'jigs byed la sogs pa gtsang ris kyi dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga dang*/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bka' dang dam la btags pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che srung zhing*/ rgya bod kyi gdan sa khyad par can rnams skyong ba bstan pa la mngon par mos pa'i lha klu mthu bo che thams cad la 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po rgyas pa dang*/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams zhabs brtan pa dang*/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi sngon gyi las dang*| 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i 'gal rkyen thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ bcu tshan gsum pa gong ltar la/ gtor ma 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa 'di/ rig 'dzin dang*/ dge sbyong*/ bram ze/ lha'i drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa rnams la 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa dar zhing sems can rnams bde ba'i dpal 'thob pa dang*/ bdag gi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi nas bsam don chos bzhin du 'grub pa'i smon lam gdab tu gsol/ bcu tshan bzhi pa sngar ltar la/ gtor ma 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa 'di/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras la 'khor rta bdag brgyad kyis bskor ba dang*/ dzaṃ bha la ser nag dmar gsum nor rgyun ma tshogs kyi bdag po la sogs pa nor lha'i tshogs dang*| lhan cig skyes pa'i lha la sogs pa bdag cag 'khor bcas la srung skyob byed pa'i lha tshogs rnams la 'bul lo// bdag cag gi nad dang dbul phongs thams cad zhi nas tshe dpal longs spyod rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod cig /bcu tshan lnga bshams la chus bran te/ yi ge gsum gyis lan gsum byin gyis brlabs la/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'dod yon phun sum tshogs par gyur ces mos te/ kha 'bar ma'i sngags bcu'am bdun nam gsum brjod la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo| |de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byam klas la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang yongs su bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod cing*/

gtor ma 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa 'di/ 'dzam bu gling gi gzhi bdag /khyad par bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma yang ma skyong ma/ sgos dbus gtsang*/ bye brag tu sa phyogs dang yul ris 'di nyid dang*/ khyad par du yang chos rje'i dge bsnyen chen po/ bar lha lha/ sog ra btsan/ chu 'phan klu/ gter sgrom sman/ tsog sna'i rnam rgyal dkar po la sogs pa lha srin sde brgyad dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba rnams la 'bul lo// 'jig rten gyi khams su char chu dus su 'bebs shing lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa dang*/ mi nad dang*/ phyugs nad/ 'khrug rtsod/ mu ge thams cad zhi zhing mi 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ bcu tshan drug pa gong ltar la/ gtor ma 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa 'di/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon pho brgyad/ mo brgyad/ gnod sbyin nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ yul 'khor skyong ba lnga brgya/ 'phrog ma ma bu la sogs pa 'brog gnas kyi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// sems can rnam la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bsam sbyor thams cad zhi nas/ chos dang mthun pa'i don thams cad sgrub pa dang*/ bdag cag gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ bcu tshan bdun pa gong ltar la/ gtor ma 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa 'di/ bgegs kyi rgyal po bi nā ya kas gtso byas/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ gdon rigs stong phrag bco brgyad| byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga/ nad bdag /rims bdag /yams kyi bdag mo thams cad la sbyin no// deng phyin chad bsam ngan dang gdug rtsub gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa thams cad zhi nas/ gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skye bar gyur cig /bcu tshan brgyad pa gong ltar la/ gtor ma 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa 'di/ 'gro ba rigs drug /lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la sbyin no// rigs drug so so'i lan chags dang bu lon thams cad byang zhing sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang bral nas/

sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa sogs drug myur du rdzogs nas 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /bcu tshan dgu pa gong ltar la/ gtor ma 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa 'di/ yi dwags kha la me 'bar mas gtso byas/ yi dwags phyi nang zas skom gyi sgrib pa can dang*/ me lce'i 'khor lo can/ byings na gnas pa/ kha 'thor ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la sbyin no// bkres skom dang dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral zhing ser sna'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad dag nas myur du sangs rgyas te/ sbyin pa rnam pa bzhi la longs spyod par gyur cig /bcu tshan bcu pa gong ltar la/ gtor ma 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa 'di/ bdag cag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du/ lan chags dang*/ bu lon ma 'khor ba dang*/ tshe 'dir spyan zur dang thugs zur la phog pa dang*/ gnod byed kyi gdon ngos ma zin pa'i tshogs thams cad la sbyin no// lan chags bral/ bu lon 'khor/ zhe 'khon dag cing phog thug tu gyur pa thams cad sos par gyur cig /gnod byed thams cad kyang gtor ma 'dis mnyes shing re ba yongs su gang ste bdag gi mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i grogs su gyur cig /bcu gcig pa brgyad tshan yang gong ltar la/ gtor ma 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa 'di/ gtor ma la re ba glo bur du lhags pa/ khas zhan pa/ dbang chung ba /skal ba chad pa/ lhag ma dang bshal chu la dbang ba rnams la sbyin no// thams cad zas skom gyis tshims zhing so so'i re 'dod gang ste dag pa'i zhing du skye bar gyur cig /ces brjod la btang ngo*// gtor theb bcu'i lnga tshar byed na so sor bshal chu btang*/ gcig tu byed na yang grub na so sor bshal chu bya zhing*/ ma grub na bcu tshan dang po dang*/ gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ bzhi pa bsdoms shing*/ lnga pa dang*/ drug pa/ bdun pa rnam bsdoms te/ brgyad pa dang*/ dgu pa/ bcu pa rnams bsdoms la/ bcu gcig pa logs su bya zhing*/

de yang ma grub na bcu tshan bzhi pa yan dang*/ lnga pa man bsdoms te re re bya zhing*/ bcu gcig pa logs su btang ngo*// nor lha chu sbyin dang*/ yi dwags/ bar do chu sbyin sogs sdon du ma grub na 'dir bya zhing*/ de dag kyang med du mi rung ba'i yan lag min pas nan gyis sbyar dgos pa ni ma yin no// de nas/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*// zhes sogs kyi chos sbyin dang*/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang de bzhin gshegs byin stobs// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs las 'phags rnams mchod pa dang*// sems can rnams la phan phyir don rnams gang bsam pa// de dag thams cad 'bad med 'byung zhing 'grub gyur cig /rgyal ba mchod pas mnyes shing dam can thugs dam skongs// rigs drug 'dod pa tshims shing lan chags bu lon 'khor// zhe 'khon sdig sgrib byang zhing tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs te// rnam dag legs par gsung ba'i sangs rgyas thob gyur cig /ces bden pa brjod/ skabs 'dir gtor gsol 'debs bya bar spro na/ mchod yon phul la gtor gsol 'debs bya/ de nas/ ma 'byor yongs su ma rnyed cing*// bdag rmongs blo yis gang bgyis pa'i// chad lhag nongs par gyur pa dag /de kun khyod kyis bzod par mdzod// ces nongs pa bshags/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ji lta'i rjes mthun dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ badzra muḥ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gang lhags pa'i// 'byung po sa 'og rgyu ba dang*// gang yang sa steng 'khod pa dang*// sa blar rgyu ba gang yin pa// mgu bar gyis la rang gnas su// thams cad dag ni 'gro bar gyi| sarba bhū ta gatstshaḥ zhes gshegs su gsol zhing bkra shis dang bsngo ba smon lam rgyas par byas la/ dmigs med kyi rgyas gdab par bya'o// gtor chog 'di nyid kyi snga phyi'i go rim ltar yongs su rdzogs pa grub na legs kyang*/
